items.q: Like Ella was there and Billy Taylor, all kinds of people.

ctx.x: He played with Benny Goodman. I know he played with Mercer. But I can’t remember, but he was dear friends with Cootie. We were like, one time, right after Duke passed, he came out with the band and there was like this like two week engagement in Bermuda and they were flying people in. Like Ella was there and Billy Taylor, all kinds of people. So they were flying in and everything worked out. So Jimmy Maxwell played in some rehearsal bands that I was in, and we got to be really good friends. And he used to say,…

in small groups with him and stuff. So the band, Duke’s band was playing at the Rainbow Grill from like Monday or Tuesday to Saturday. Sunday nights they didn’t play. But that band was sax section, trumpet, and rhythm section. They used the same charts. And somehow, his music is so heavy that it’s just worked. They know how to play it. Did you ever hear the album “The Unknown Sessions?”
